definitions.explanation: Indicates that something meets or exceeds the required level or amount. Used to confirm that a condition has been satisfactorily met.

definitions.gloss: fully; thoroughly; to a great extent
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes completeness or thoroughness of an action. Conveys that something was done without cutting corners.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to examine this matter thoroughly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to get enough nutrition.

examples.japanese: お{気持|きも}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{分|わ}かります→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I fully understand how you feel.

notes:
Adverbial form of ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ (sufficient; enough) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Also written {充分|じゅうぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ with different kanji — both are standard and interchangeable, though ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ is more common. The word ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ can also function as a na-adjective: ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}な→十分な：25503_juubunna⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (a sufficient amount).

Note: {十分|じっぷん} (ten minutes) is a different word with different kanji reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exercise great caution
- {十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧: to fully understand
- {十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧: to thoroughly examine
- {十分|じゅうぶん}に⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to rest well

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧: plenty; more than enough — more colloquial, implies generous abundance
- {充分|じゅうぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: sufficiently — variant kanji spelling, same pronunciation and meaning
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧: firmly; thoroughly — emphasizes doing something properly and reliably
